notes: vocabulary[i] is the n-gram with feature index i (offset by earlier vectorizers). Probabilities are softmax(coef . x + intercept), x = l2-normalised sublinear TF-IDF per vectorizer.

training.split: train_test_split(test_size=0.2, stratify=label, random_state=42) on the original seed rows
training.allow_min_prob_rule: smallest threshold with out-of-fold false-ALLOW <= 1% on the training split
